bio.text: David Pan is the Republican candidate for California's 46th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was born in Chicago, Illinois, lives in California, and holds an undergraduate degree from Stanford University and a graduate degree from Columbia University.
Since 2006 he has been a professor of German at the University of California, Irvine, and he previously worked as a management consultant at McKinsey and Company in Los Angeles.
